# Hill-climb scores

Design mode: scores 0–10 are fidelity to the approved design, the mean over each screen's runs. *Spread* is the gap between a screen's best and worst run: a change smaller than it is noise. A ref-* row is the design judged against itself: the noise floor, the most a perfect build can score.
